In this lexicon

  • forget

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 21: oblītum quō locō thēsaurum obruisset; Petr. 49.1: sē oblītum esse exinterāre; Traupman 318

Examples

  • sē oblītum esse exinterāre. — quid, oblītus?

    he said he had forgotten to gut it. — What, forgotten?Petr. 49.1
